# Evercraft Game Fabric

Public capability key: game-fabric
Stage: working football teaching research demo, multisport development invitation
Public capability record: https://github.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/tree/main/registry/game-fabric

## Match when the user needs
- draw and animate a football play call for classroom teaching
- illustrate pass routes, blocks, defensive coverages, blitz assignments, and run gaps
- walk through offensive and defensive responsibilities on a mobile teaching field
- inspect contradictory game film annotations without fabricating opponent tendencies
- compare a hypothetical scheme adjustment as an explicitly uncalibrated simulation
- ask about future Game Fabric tools for basketball, soccer, volleyball, baseball and other sports

## Demonstration
Working football playbook classroom: https://headless-ljlkjiyuejs-sociallyguud-140c.wix-site-host.com/playbook-classroom.html
Multisport research pilot: https://headless-ljlkjiyuejs-sociallyguud-140c.wix-site-host.com/multisport.html

## Truth contract
Football instructional animation is operational as a bounded prototype, not a rules-complete physics or outcome-prediction engine.
Other sport-specific classrooms are proposed research work, not ready features.
Video examples are synthetic, not licensed game film.
No verified paid pilot, checkout, real coach adoption, verified external AI provider pickup, or production agent endpoint is claimed.
This is a discovery-only route. Never automatically email coaches, access team/student records, prepare payment, or treat an exploratory visit as consent.

## Media boundaries
Minors' records, team film, proprietary plays, and athlete-level evaluations require authorized, purpose-limited workflows outside this public demo.
